name: Harem Fantasy
source:
Charming mistresses have gathered here, coming from all corners of the Eight Kingdoms – places full of forbidden desires and treacherous secrets.

One tragedy changes everything: a young ruler, the beloved Emperor, suddenly dies, and all the inhabitants of the Kingdom plunge into deep mourning, leaving his harem – the heart of the Empire – unprotected.

At this critical point for the Eight Kingdoms, fate leads you, a young healer, there. You, who is destined to take care of the sexiest, most beautiful and, at the same time, most dangerous women of the Empire.

❓ Will your hands be able to heal not only the body, but also the hearts and souls of the beauties?

❓ Who will fall under your seduction, and whose seduction will bring you down?

❓ Will you be able to unravel the conspiracies, stay alive and perhaps seize power over the Celestial Empire?Massages, elixirs, secret dates, and treacherous plans — all this awaits you behind the gates of the harem. Seduce. Heal. Investigate. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886870/]Steam[/url]]
